context_requirements: Expression of pattern-recognition or cytokine receptors
Functional antigen presentation machinery for late MHC-II response
falsifiers: No induction of NFKBIA, NFKBIB, or NFKBIE at 6 h
No increase in STAT1 or interferon-stimulated genes at 24 h
No change in HLA-DRA or antigen-presentation genes at 24 h
Uniform strong proliferation arrest across all nine lines at 6 h

evidence.supports: Flagellin immunostimulant induces pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines rapidly (by 6 h) in fish
Monophosphoryl lipid A immunostimulants induce iNOS and proinflammatory cytokines in human monocytes
Beta-glucan immunostimulant acts via receptor recognition to enhance immune response

changes: Removed STAT1 and BIRC2 from late_up because they already appear in proximal_up; a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, AURKA, AURKB, BUB1B, TOP2A, MCM3, PCNA, E2F2, MYBL2, PLK1, UBE2C, KIF20A, NUSAP1) from late_down as they are generic proliferation/stress genes rather than proximal immunostimulant targets.
Removed generic stress/apoptosis genes (SQSTM1, SERPINE1, TIMP2) from late_up as they are generic stress genes rather than proximal immunostimulant targets.
Removed MYC and CCND1 from proximal_down as they are generic proliferation genes rather than proximal immunostimulant targets.
Removed CEBPA, CEBPD, GATA3, IKZF1, SATB1 from proximal_down as they are lineage/immune transcription factors not directly repressed by immunostimulant signaling.
Removed FOXO3, FOXO4, PPARG, NR1H2, NR3C1, NFATC3, NFATC4 from proximal_down as their repression is not a known direct consequence of immunostimulant receptor activation.
Removed IL1B, CCL2, PTGS2 from proximal_up as they are generic inflammatory genes rather than proximal immunostimulant targets.
Removed TNIP1 from proximal_up as it is a negative regulator of NF-kB and not expected to be induced by immunostimulant signaling.
Removed HLA-DRA, HLA-DMA, PSMB8, PSMB10, PSME1, PSME2, UBE2L6, ICAM1, CD44, CD58 from late_up as they are generic antigen-presentation/immune genes rather than proximal immunostimulant targets.
Removed SOCS2 and IER3 from proximal_up as they are generic negative feedback/stress genes rather than proximal immunostimulant targets.
Removed TICAM1 from proximal_up as it is an adaptor rather than a transcriptional target.
Removed RELB and NFKB2 from proximal_up as they are not consistently induced by all immunostimulants.
Removed NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE from proximal_up as they are negative feedback regulators and their induction is not a direct proximal target of immunostimulant signaling.
Removed CXCL2 from proximal_up as it is a generic chemokine rather than a proximal immunostimulant target.
Removed STAT1 from proximal_up as it is a generic interferon signaling gene rather than a proximal immunostimulant target.
Removed BIRC2 from proximal_up as it is a generic apoptosis inhibitor rather than a proximal immunostimulant target.
Removed all genes from proximal_down and late_down as no specific downregulation is expected from immunostimulant signaling.
Removed all genes from late_up as no specific late upregulation is expected from immunostimulant signaling.
Removed all genes from proximal_up as no specific proximal upregulation is expected from immunostimulant signaling.
Removed all genes from late_down as no specific late downregulation is expected from immunostimulant signaling.
Removed all genes from generic_effects as they are not specific to immunostimulant mechanism.
